candidates.change_summary: Change the airdrop amount from 20 to 21 tokens.
Credit a fixed address instead of msg.sender, so the balance at the caller's key differs.
Invert the hasNoBalance check so only callers with a nonzero balance can call airDrop.
Compare against the wrong string so supportsToken always fails and airDrop reverts.
Remove the unlock so the second airDrop call reverts due to the permanent lock.
Remove `_locked = true;` so reentrancy protection is disabled and airDrop can be re-entered mid-execution.
Remove `_locked = false;` so the lock is never released and any second airDrop call reverts.
Change the airdrop amount from 20 to 21 tokens credited per call.
Remove the balance update so airDrop no longer credits tokens to the caller.
Invert the hasNoBalance check so airDrop only proceeds when the caller already has a balance.
Invert the supportsToken equality check so airDrop reverts for the legitimate Bank caller.
